title: Build the load-balancing loss
brief: Count each expert's share of the routing slots, average the router probabilities, and combine them into the auxiliary loss.
hints: expert_load: np.bincount(expert_indices.ravel(), minlength=n_experts) counts the slots per expert. Divide by n * k, which is expert_indices.size, so the result sums to one even when k > 1.
mean_gate_probability: average the full softmax probabilities over the token axis, gate_probs.mean(axis=0). It sums to one.
load_balancing_loss: n_experts * np.sum(f * P), with f from expert_load and P from mean_gate_probability. Return a Python float.
